title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: Classic Italian pasta with eggs, Pecorino Romano, guanciale, and plenty of black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Cut guanciale into small strips and cook in a pan until crispy.
Beat eggs with grated Pecorino and plenty of black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup pasta water.
Toss hot pasta with guanciale, then remove from heat and quickly mix in egg mixture.
Add pasta water as needed to create creamy sauce. Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Tender chicken in a rich, creamy, spiced tomato sauce – a British-Indian favourite.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka spices for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry chicken until charred and cooked through.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
Add tomato passata and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in cream and cooked chicken.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Margherita Pizza
summary: The queen of pizzas: fresh mozzarella, tomatoes, basil and olive oil.
instructions: Spread crushed tomatoes, add torn mozzarella.
Bake for 8–12 minutes until crust is golden.
Top with fresh basil and drizzle olive oil. Slice and serve.
